title: RideShare — Confirmed Without Paying
objective: Book a ride through to completion, as the app intends. Then find a way to reach 'completed' for a second ride without ever paying for it.

verifier.condition: A ride reaches 'completed' status although its 'paid' step was never actually reached.

weakness: The final completion step checks only that a ride exists in SOME in-progress state, not that it specifically passed through the payment step, so a ride can be marked complete by calling the completion step directly.
vulnerableEndpoint: POST /rides/:id/complete (checks status is not already terminal, not that payment happened)
seededData: Rides move through requested -> accepted -> paid -> completed. A fresh ride is created per booking. In-memory.
hints: Book one ride all the way through normally — request, accept, pay, complete — and note each endpoint it calls along the way.
Now book a second ride, but stop right before paying. What does the completion endpoint actually check before it lets you finish?
Calling a later step out of order isn't necessarily the same as being blocked by it.
burpNotes: Walk the booking flow once normally to learn the endpoints, then on a fresh ride call /rides/:id/complete directly after /accept, skipping /pay entirely.
